title: A drawn path takes an outline inside, centred or outside
goal: A drawn path has an outline width, caps and joins in the panel but no way to say where the outline sits. The icon drawing mock has an Align row under Stroke (Center for a glyph), and a Figma or Illustrator user expects inside, center and outside. The document and the drawing already know where an outline sits; only the control is missing. Add the mock Align row so a person can keep an outline inside a shape or centred on the path.
notes: Manager review 2026-10-08 of icon-svg. Model: PathContent.strokePosition (Sources/PhotonzCore, BorderPosition .inside/.center/.outside with displayName Inside/Center/Outside), drawn through BorderPosition.swift around line 103 (strokePosition.outset); annotation defaults set it in AnnotationStyles.swift. Nothing in Sources/Photonz sets it for a path (grep strokePosition). Reuse the picker the Border effect already uses: EffectsListInspector.swift BorderPositionRow (around 333-440) and EditorState+ColorStyles.swift setBorderEffectPosition. Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/icon-draw-wt.html around line 421 (Stroke section: Width, Caps, Align Center). Line style pickers: PathLineStylePickers.swift. The mock draws it, so no card. Check SVG export handles inside/outside (SVG has no stroke alignment; an inside stroke is usually written as a clip or a doubled width with a clip).
acceptance: A picked drawn path shows Align with Inside, Center and Outside in its outline settings, beside Width, Caps and Joins, as icon-draw-wt.html draws it (a dropdown reading Center)
Changing it redraws the outline at once, on several picked paths together, as one undo step; an open path offers Center only or says why the others do not apply
Exported SVG and the picture export agree with the canvas for each choice (an inside or outside outline on a closed path comes out where it shows); a test in PhotonzCore or PhotonzRender pins the SVG

At Next defaults, no switch. A walk draws a closed path with the pen, sets Align to Outside and checks the readout and a picture. Try: draw a closed shape with P, pick it, set the outline width to 4, change Align. Audit written under queue/audits/ side by side with the mock Stroke section
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task log if it does not

log.note: Before building: model (PathContent.strokePosition), PathRasterizer and SVG export already handled all three (inside = double width clipped, outside = double width masked); SVGExportRenderTests already matched pictures. Gap was only the control. Figma/Illustrator users expect Inside/Center/Outside in that order; the Border effect asks the same question with the same dropdown, so reused it. Open paths: kept the row (mock shows Align on a glyph), Inside/Outside dimmed with the reason in the tip.

Built: PhotonzDocument.setPathStrokePosition (closed paths only, one undo step via perform), PathLineStyleSelection.alignReading/hasAnInside (reads closed paths only so an open one beside them never reads Mixed), PathStrokeAlignRow in PathLineStylePickers.swift after Corners. Tests: Tests/PhotonzCoreTests/PathStrokeAlignTests.swift (setter, reading, old files open centred, SVG words for each choice). Full suite 11876 green.

Walks: path-outline-align-walk (Center, Outside, Inside, undo; two paths together and one undo; open path reads Center; 5 real captures; renders differ from Center in the shape's box; SVGs carry mask/clip) and path-outline-align-click-walk (pointer click on the dropdown face opens it and Outside lands). Both green at Next defaults. path-line-style-walk and path-arrives-with-no-edge-walk still green.

Mock differences outside this task (Width vs Thickness, Caps vs Ends, Stroke section vs Outline row) filed as p1 a-drawn-path-s-outline-settings-read-like-the-ic. Left rough, no task: at the default 4pt on a large canvas the move between Center and Outside is subtle to see; that is the weight, not the control.
